headline: [Indian Stocks] Market Falls on Rising Oil Prices and Inflation Fears, Consumer Goods Sector Hit Hard by Oil Impact
summary: Indian stocks fell as uncertainty over reopening the Strait of Hormuz and a possible US-Iran agreement pushed oil prices higher. The Sensex 30 index fell 0.49%.
why: India is a large oil importer, so higher crude prices raise inflation and input costs for consumer and industrial companies.
why_moved: Uncertainty over reopening the Strait of Hormuz and a possible US-Iran agreement lifted oil prices. Higher oil raised inflation fears and prompted profit-taking, hitting consumer goods stocks.
